an5.59:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] pañcahi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato dullabho buḍḍhapabbajito.
an5.59:1.3: dullabho bhikkhave buḍḍhapabbajito nipuṇo, dullabho ākappasampanno, dullabho bahussuto, dullabho dhammakathiko, dullabho vinayadharo.
an5.59:1.4: imehi kho bhikkhave pañcahi dhammehi samannāgato dullabho buḍḍhapabbajito’ti.
